relationships.subject: PAR2
relationships.evidence_quote: Upon activation of PAR1 and PAR2 receptors, sensory neurons release CGRP and substance P which then elicit neurogenic pain.

relationships.subject: mast cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Mucosal biopsies in IBS exhibit higher stored mediators like histamine and tryptase and neo‐formed lipid mediators like PGE2 with associated increases in COX2 mRNA and protein expression

relationships.subject: COX2
relationships.evidence_quote: Rapid increases in COX2 gene expression in inflamed tissues are followed by PGD2, PGE 2 , PGF 2 , PGI2, and thromboxane (TX) biosynthesis.

key_findings: Review: mast cell PGE2/COX2, tryptase and histamine drive visceral hypersensitivity and permeability defects in IBS
Mast cells lie closer to CGRP/substance P and TRPV1 nerve fibers in IBS, correlating with pain severity
